lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x
  by_contra hx
  have hc := Continuous.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (λ_ => f x) hf continuous_const
  have hp := lt_of_le_of_ne' real_inner_self_nonneg' $ inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx
  obtain ⟨φ, hs, hk, hd, hn, hφ⟩ := exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset $ hc.continuousAt.eventually_const_lt hp
  refine' ((hd.continuous.fun_mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero hk.mul_right ?_ $ by rw [hφ, one_mul]; apply hp.ne').ne' $ by
    simpa only [inner_smul_right'] using hg _ $ IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨hd, hk⟩ contDiff_const
  intro y
  by_cases hy : y ∈ tsupport φ
  · exact mul_nonneg (Set.range_subset_iff.1 hn y).1 (hs hy).le
  · simp [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hy]

theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  rcases UpdateStatesUpdated hu ▸ InitStatesUpdated hi
  repeat constructor
  apply updatedStatesInit
  rotate_left
  apply UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' _ hu
  apply InitStatesNotDefined hi
  apply InitStatesNodup hi
  unfold updatedStates
  rewrite [updatedStatesComm]
  apply updatedStatesUpdate
  rotate_left
  apply updatedStatesDefMonotone
  apply UpdateStatesDefined' hu
  all_goals simp [List.unzip_zip, UpdateStatesLength hu, InitStatesLength hi]
  intro k hk hk'
  cases InitStatesNotDefined hi k hk' ▸ UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  let f := (mulLinearMap.comp (mulLinearMap.flip c)).compr₂ (ι.toLinearMap.comp timeOrderF)
  let g := mulLinearMap.compr₂ (ι.toLinearMap.comp ((mulLinearMap c).comp timeOrderF))
  suffices h : f = g from congrArg (fun k => k a b) h
  apply LinearMap.ext_basis ofCrAnListFBasis ofCrAnListFBasis
  intro l r
  simp only [f, g, LinearMap.compr₂_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply,
    AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, mulLinearMap_apply, ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
  conv_lhs =>
    arg 2
    simp only [c, superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, mul_sub, sub_mul,
      mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, map_sub, map_smul, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
      ← ofCrAnListF_append, List.singleton_append, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.append_assoc,
      timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
    rw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
    rw [smul_comm, ← smul_sub]
    simp only [crAnTimeOrderList,
      show l ++ φ :: ψ :: r = l ++ [φ, ψ] ++ r by simp,
      show l ++ ψ :: φ :: r = l ++ [ψ, φ] ++ r by simp,
      insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ l [φ, ψ] r (by simp_all),
      insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ l [ψ, φ] r (by simp_all),
      ofCrAnListF_append, smul_mul_assoc]
    arg 2
    simp only [mul_assoc]
    rw [← mul_smul_comm, ← mul_smul_comm, ← mul_sub, ← mul_sub,
      ← smul_mul_assoc, ← sub_mul]
    simp only [ofCrAnListF_cons, ofCrAnListF_nil, mul_one]
    rw [← smul_mul_assoc, ← superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
  simp only [map_smul, map_mul, ← mul_assoc]
  rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
  simp only [mul_assoc, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
  have h := insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ l r
  simp only [decide_not, Bool.decide_and, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append] at h ⊢
  rw [← h, ← crAnTimeOrderList]
  by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
  · simp [c, ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq]
  · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ (by simp_all),
      ← crAnTimeOrderSign, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
    simp only [c, List.nil_append, map_mul, map_smul, mul_smul_comm]

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var => simp_all
  any_goals solve_by_elim
  case' app l _ _ _ => have := l.canonical_form_abs
  case' tapp d _ _ => have := d.canonical_form_tabs
  case' case d _ _ _ _ _ => have := d.canonical_form_sum
  all_goals repeat' first | simp_all only [body_let, body_case, true_implies] | casesm* _ ∧ _, _ ∨ _, Exists _, Value (.inl _), Value (.inr _) | cases lc
  all_goals first | left; solve_by_elim | right; solve_by_elim only [*, Exists.intro, Red.appᵣ, Red.abs, Red.tabs, Red.let_body, Red.case_inl, Red.case_inr, Red.case]
